recipes.name: Instant Pink Taco Sauce
ingredients: 1/2 cup sour cream - substitute yogurt for lower calorie (, or add mayonnaise for richness)
4 tsp sriracha ((or other hot sauce - start with less and add to taste))
instructions: Mix ingredients until smooth. If you want a looser drizzling texture, add a tiny bit of water.

page_recipe_notes: Recipe Notes: 1. Non-spicy version – substitute the sriracha with 3 tablespoons of ketchup (or Aussie tomato sauce) + 1/4 tsp finely minced garlic + 1/4 tsp salt + 1/2 tsp lemon juice or clear vinegar.
